298 K α 石英：镜像还是换基？: α-Quartz at 298 K: mirror image or change of basis?
原始结构属于空间群 154。先预测两种操作各得到 152 还是 154。第一种固: The original structure is in space group 154. Predict whether each operation gives 152 or 154. First, negate the fractional coordinates with the lattice held fixed. Second, negate both the lattice basis vectors and the fractional coordinates.
逐一载入原始 CIF、主动镜像和被动换基，手动转换到 BC。记下空间群号和位点数: Load the original CIF, the active mirror image, and the passive change of basis one at a time. Manually convert each to BC and record the space-group number and site count.
比较 154 与 152。先只允许保持取向，再允许反转取向。载入每组设置后手动运: Compare 154 and 152. Allow only orientation-preserving changes first, then allow orientation reversal. Run the calculation manually after loading each setting.
原始、主动镜像、被动换基依次得到 154、152、154，各有 9 个位点。固定: The original, active mirror image, and passive change of basis give 154, 152, and 154, respectively, with nine sites in each. With the lattice held fixed, negating the fractional coordinates inverts the Cartesian positions of the atoms. Negating both the lattice basis vectors and the fractional coordinates cancels the two minus signs, leaving the Cartesian positions unchanged.
对于给定候选 I 和 −I，154 与 152 的完整目录操作集在允许反转取向时: Among the supplied candidates I and −I, the complete catalog operation sets for 154 and 152 match by −I with an origin shift when orientation reversal is allowed. The standardized result of the passive change of basis matches space group 154 by I.
完整 CIF 来自 Kihara 的 298 K 衍射研究。两份对照由其晶格和原: The complete CIF comes from Kihara’s 298 K diffraction study. Both comparison structures are derived from its lattice and atomic coordinates. This exercise compares atomic geometry and space-group operations. Experimental optical rotation requires a separate measurement and an explicit convention.
